Since 2013, StartUp Bahrain has been the national ecosystem and community for innovative scalable startups.
The Startup Bahrain ecosystem is not just a place, it’s a movement – a movement of change-makers who are driven by a shared vision of creating a better world through their startups.
What does StartUp Bahrain offer?
There are lots of programs and workshops happening for startups in Bahrain!
Can StartUp Bahrain promote my event?
StartUp Bahrain promotes events that are startup-related, around technology, investment, skills, and more.

Application Criteria Your startup needs to meet the following criteria when applying for StartUp Bahrain Pitch . ✔︎ A minimum viable product ready to showcase. ✔︎ A high potential for scalability with an innovative concept. ✔︎ A product/service relevant to the local/regional market. ✔︎ Be Bahrain-based with an existing Commercial Registration (CR). ✔︎ Have at least one Bahraini founder. The criteria may be adjusted from time to time based on the requirements of the program. Requirements To participate, you need to first apply to StartUp Bahrain Pitch, this process is easy. Fill out the application form, wait for your application to be reviewed, and hear back with an acceptance or rejection. Information Required Personal Information : Your name, email, phone number, nationality, age, and government-issued Identity Card number. Employment & Educational : Your current employment status and educational background. Startup : Commercial

Sheikh Mohammed bin Mubarak Al Khalifa, was held on April 28, 2019 at the Gulf Hotel Bahrain. The Information and eGovernment Authority has organized the award ceremony to recognize various talents around the Kingdom and reward them for their achievements. One of our very own Bahraini startups, AlRawi , has won under the category of Best Application for Smart Devices. AlRawi won the award because of its successful app that has an impact on society, the ability to provide effective communication to the audience, and the degree of effectiveness in society. Founded by Hala Sulaiman , Ameera Al-Qubaiti, and Mohamed Ebrahim, Alrawi is a platform to make books and cultural content more accessible to a wider audience in the Arab world. To encourage continuous learning, AlRawi Books has a wide variety of audiobooks in Arabic that cater to those who want to read books with busy schedules. Applications are open for Bahrain FinTech Bay’s ambitious National FinTech Talent Program - StartUp Bahrain Ecosystem Guide Pitch Weekend Blog Perks Resources Bahrain About Contact Applications are open for Bahrain FinTech Bay’s ambitious National FinTech Talent Program Aug 26, 2019 Eyes set on incorporating fresh blood into the country’s burgeoning FinTech ecosystem, Bahrain FinTech Bay (BFB) will soon be launching its flagship National FinTech Talent Program, supported by Tamkeen. The program is open for Bahrainis who are fresh graduates and looking to gain some experience within the FinTech field and to master the skills and knowledge needed to begin a career in the field. The program will be divided into the following steps: Career Fair: Applicants will be invited to a career fair on September 19 with networking opportunities to over 30 potential employees in one roof. 6- month internship: The internship, starting in October, will enable candidates to receive training and mentorship from BFB partners across corporates, financial institutions, and universities from across the region and beyond. Georgetown FinTech Program: Study with a leading business school, spread across 12 weeks with two live sessions in Bahrain. The course will begin in October 2019 and end on January 2020. Blockchain & AI Academies: BFB will organize a special training session on Blockchain & AI

Applications are open now for Georgetown FinTech Program 2.0 - StartUp Bahrain Ecosystem Guide Pitch Weekend Blog Perks Resources Bahrain About Contact Applications are open now for Georgetown FinTech Program 2.0 Aug 27, 2019 The second cohort of the prestigious Georgetown FinTech Program will kick off on Oct 26, 2019, with the vision of enabling candidates to comprehend the scope of FinTech and how disruptive technologies can be used to pave the way for new opportunities. Whether you work for an Islamic retail bank aiming to go digital, or simply an employee looking to get out of your comfort zone and establish your own FinTech startup, you will benefit from applying for this program. The minimum educational qualification of the applicant must be a Bachelor's degree or higher. In addition, the applicant must also have fluency in English in addition to a minimum of two years of work experience in any of finance, technology, or other related fields. The shortlisted candidates will be charged BHD 2,500 (approx $6,630) as the program fee for the six-month-long program. So if you have always wanted to pursue a career in the cutting-edge FinTech sector in the region, this is the one opportunity you don't want to miss out on!
